# Menu Item Schema

version: 0.1.0

type: object
description: Canonical Menu-Item Object Model
required:
  - key
  - name
  - order
  - action

properties:
  key: { type: string }
  udi: { type: string }
  name: { type: string }
  icon: { type: string }
  colourScheme: { type: string }
  type: { type: string }

  selectionMethod:
    type: string
    enum:
      - number
      - toggle
      - multi-toggle
      - slider
      - carousel
      - text-input
      - none

  order: { type: integer }

  action:
    type: string
    enum: [execute, navigate, back, exit, noop]

  executeTarget: { type: string }
  navigateTarget: { type: string }

  visibilityMode:
    type: string
    enum: [Static, Conditional, Hidden]

  visibilityCondition: { type: string }

  visibilityDependencies:
    type: array
    items: { type: string }

  enableMode:
    type: string
    enum: [Enabled, Disabled, Conditional]

  enableCondition: { type: string }

  enableDependencies:
    type: array
    items: { type: string }

  registryKey: { type: string }
  registryOverrides: { type: object }

# UDI Menu Item Schema
# Supports: action items, navigation items (submenus), header items
# ui_framework refers to pane layout (basic, single_pane, two_pane, menu, custom)

type: object

version: 0.2.0

required:
  - key
  - name
  - type
  - order
  - selectionMethod
  - action
  - ui_framework
  - capability

properties:

  key:
    type: string
    description: Unique identifier for the menu item.

  name:
    type: string
    description: Human-readable label or header text.

  type:
    type: string
    enum:
      - action
      - navigate
      - header
    description: |
      Item class:
        - action: executes a capability
        - navigate: opens a submenu
        - header: non-interactive, non-numbered

  order:
    type: integer
    description: |
      Determines placement in the menu.
      Header items use order only for positioning.

  selectionMethod:
    type: string
    enum:
      - number
      - toggle
      - multi-toggle
      - slider
      - carousel
      - text-input
      - none
    description: |
      Input method.
      Header items MUST use: none.

  action:
    type: string
    enum:
      - execute
      - navigate
      - back
      - exit
      - none
    description: |
      Action performed when selected.
      Header items MUST use: none.

  ui_framework:
    type: string
    enum:
      - basic
      - menu
      - single_pane
      - two_pane
      - custom
    description: |
      Defines pane layout:
        - basic: raw terminal
        - menu: menu-style pane
        - single_pane: one bordered pane
        - two_pane: two bordered panes
        - custom: wizard/dashboard/multi-pane

  capability:
    type: string
    description: |
      Capability routed to agent.
      Header items MUST use: "none".

  navigateTarget:
    type: string
    nullable: true
    description: Required when action = navigate.

  executeTarget:
    type: string
    nullable: true
    description: Required when action = execute.

  icon:
    type: string
    nullable: true
    description: Optional icon metadata.

  colourScheme:
    type: string
    nullable: true
    description: Optional colour scheme override.

  description:
    type: string
    nullable: true
    description: Extended help text.

  tags:
    type: array
    items:
      type: string
    nullable: true
    description: Metadata tags.

  visibilityMode:
    type: string
    enum:
      - static
      - conditional
      - hidden
    nullable: true
    description: Visibility control mode.

  visibilityCondition:
    type: string
    nullable: true
    description: |
      Expression controlling visibility.
      Example: user.groups.contains('admin')

  visibilityDependencies:
    type: array
    items:
      type: string
    nullable: true
    description: Keys referenced by visibilityCondition.

  enableMode:
    type: string
    enum:
      - enabled
      - disabled
      - conditional
    nullable: true
    description: Enablement mode.

  enableCondition:
    type: string
    nullable: true
    description: Expression controlling enablement.

  enableDependencies:
    type: array
    items:
      type: string
    nullable: true
    description: Keys referenced by enableCondition.

  registryKey:
    type: string
    nullable: true
    description: Lookup key in menu item registry.

  registryOverrides:
    type: object
    nullable: true
    description: Override registry defaults.

  style:
    type: object
    nullable: true
    description: tUilKit style metadata.

  borderScheme:
    type: string
    nullable: true
    description: Optional border override (headers commonly use this).

  metadata:
    type: object
    nullable: true
    description: Arbitrary UDI metadata block.

additionalProperties: false
